resumen: Push-ups with the hands on a bench. With the hands higher than the feet, the arms support less weight: the way to start when push-ups on the floor are still hard.
ejecucion: Put your hands on the edge of a bench, a little wider than your shoulders, and walk your feet back.
Make a straight line from head to heels, with your abs tight.
Lower by bending your elbows until your chest nears the edge of the bench.
Push the bench away until your arms are straight, without your hips sagging or rising.
matices: The study that measured forces in several push-ups found that raising the hands on a box loads the arms less than a regular push-up. Another study, in the regular and knee push-up, found that the arms support more weight at the bottom than at the top.
